name: Hollow Sunless Magistrate
loreTies: A false judge created from stolen Aten Ra law; it issues verdicts that erase context and leave only punishment.
Corrupts capture points and reverses sustain if not interrupted.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Sunless Magistrate is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into elite battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Sunless Magistrate formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Deity, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Corrupts capture points and reverses sustain if not interrupted. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A false judge created from stolen Aten Ra law; it issues verdicts that erase context and leave only punishment.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Sunless Magistrate can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Sunless Magistrate visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses tall robed absence with bronze-black scales, faceless sun disk cracked in half, floating judgment shards. while its abilities — Null Verdict, Sentence the Bright, Law Inversion — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Deity.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
